explanation: Zero everywhere except the GO step right after a trial where the agent chose a1, landed in S1 by the common transition, and got no reward (if that trial went to S2, rare, or was rewarded, or was an a2 trial, it stays 0). Here it reaches about 10 when that loss follows rewarded trials around trials 40-70 and the agent picks a1 again, about 3-6 if the trial before was also a loss, late in the episode (80+), or the agent switches to a2, and about 2 before trial 35.
